title: Hyderabad: Fire breaks out at Santoshnagar school, no injuries
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
key_facts: Fire broke out at Hyderabad school, officials said.
Reports suggest the cause of the fire is not yet confirmed.
The operation was carried out at Santoshnagar.
The incident came to light on Tuesday.
